description: 110年度全臺839子集水區範圍圖 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 供110年度全臺839子集水區範圍圖圖資shp下載檔案，內容包括BASINID(主流代碼)、BASINNAME(主流名稱)、WSID(子集水區代碼)、WSNAME(子集水區名稱)、BRANCH(分局名稱)、RECORD(子集水區調整說明)、AREAM2(子集水區面積(單位：平方公尺))。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
